how visual analytics can be used for the following: (1) course design and improvement, (2) student support, (3) education research, (4) university management, (5) MOOC provider support, and (6) student self-reflection and self-learning.
how to use visual analytics to help understand MOOCs and improve MOOC education.
how to help people make sense of MOOC data and what new insights can be gained from visual analytics.
